title: A notes app
oneLine: Write, organise, search, on every device.
why: A single-device notes app is a first-week project. Sync across devices and never losing a note are what you're really paying for, and they are genuinely hard. Obsidian itself is free; its sync is the paid part, and you can replace that with a free git or cloud-folder setup instead of building anything.
tool: Obsidian (free) plus a free sync folder, rather than building
keep: Reliable sync, collaboration, the mobile apps.
breaks: Sync conflicts. Two devices editing the same note is the oldest unsolved problem in software.
